_comment: CURATED THROWBACKS (2026-09-22). A card that stops being a reward and qualifies for no other set — not a rookie year, not the career's best season, not a playoff run, not the current season — becomes a Throwback, by the user's rule (2026-09-18): "If a card does not qualify for super season or rookie (or dissonance), 26-27, they should be throwbacks." These are built by scripts/cardgen/generateCuratedCards.js through the Free Agents builder into card-data/generated/cards-throwbacks.json, a GENERATOR-OWNED file — never into cards-free-agents.json, which the Card Studio writes whole. Throwbacks ids always carry the season (Bradley_Beal_2021). Rows: bbrefId, name, season (the end year), set, why.

cards.name: Bradley Beal
cards.why: The Wizards reward until 2026-09-18, when John Wall's 2016-17 Super Season took the goal (the user: "Go with Vince, Wall and Brand"). His 31-a-game year is nobody's best season by the rule (2018-19 is) and not his rookie year (2012-13, carded), so it keeps its card as a Throwback rather than vanishing. Nobody had earned it: "No one has them yet, it doesn't matter. But it should just change face."

cards.name: Blake Griffin
cards.why: the user, 2026-09-30: "I think we def need a Blake Clippers card if we don't have one other than the rookie." His best season is the 2018-19 Pistons card (Detroit's reward), so this is a Throwback.

cards.name: Lou Williams
cards.why: the user, 2026-09-30: "we need some Lou Will somewhere too. Something that makes him useful as a 6th man, but not too expensive." His Sixth Man award seasons price $1,030-1,260; 2019-20 with the Clippers is $800.

cards.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
cards.why: the Complete 2026-27 Set reward from 2026-09-30, built here and moved into set-rewards (set-rewards-2026.json nba-set).

cards.name: Shawn Marion
cards.why: the user, 2026-09-30: "we need some Marion cards". 2006-07 is his most valuable season, but his 1999-2000 rookie card beats it, so it is not a Super Season; it keeps a card as a Throwback beside the rookie card.

cards.name: Baron Davis
cards.why: the user, 2026-09-30, on a photo left in the team-rewards folder from the first reward picks (2026-09-04): "Can we re-assign that somewhere?" and, shown the plan, "Yeah go for it". The photo is the Warriors of the We Believe year; his most valuable season is New Orleans 2003-04, so this one is a Throwback.

cards.name: Corey Maggette
cards.why: the user, 2026-09-30, on a photo left in the team-rewards folder from the first reward picks (2026-09-04): "Can we re-assign that somewhere?" and, shown the plan, "Yeah go for it". The photo is a Clippers one; 2007-08 (22.1 a game) is not the season the value pick calls his best, so it is a Throwback.

cards.name: Antawn Jamison
cards.why: The photo in the team-rewards folder is a Wizards one, taken for 2007-08. It was his Super Season until the real-log rebuild (2026-09-30, evening) made 2000-01 with Golden State (41 minutes a game) his most valuable season; 2007-08 never shipped as a Super Season, so it keeps a card here as a Throwback, with the photo.

cards.name: DeMarcus Cousins
cards.why: the user, 2026-09-30, on a photo left in the team-rewards folder from the first reward picks (2026-09-04): "Can we re-assign that somewhere?" and, shown the plan, "Yeah go for it". The photo is a Kings one; his Super Season (2016-17) wears New Orleans by the last-team rule, so the Sacramento years had no card. 2015-16, his All-NBA season.
